page.notes: The underlined Q in "Quod" is printed with an underline beneath it; transcribed as Quod. The closing line is set in spaced small capitals; the hyphen after PHYSI is the printed line-end hyphen. Stain at the bottom edge of the page and show-through are not transcribed. The page number is read as 336; the old-style digits are clear enough but the first digit is small.
